paragraph: The Granville composite timing system registers a perfectly balanced reading of 50 out of 100 this morning, delivering a strictly neutral primary verdict with no active breadth divergence warnings to flag. This flat baseline is mirrored across the board, as all key underlying sub-signals—including RSP/SPY breadth, HYG/LQD credit confidence, and SOXX/SPY semiconductor leadership—are currently yielding neutral, flat readings. With broader macro volatility and credit conditions also quiet, the market currently lacks any of the internal divergence or defensive rotation typically used to forecast intermediate momentum shifts. Consequently, the lack of leadership from high-beta sectors or transportation proxies suggests a market temporarily stripped of its directional bias. Given this absolute equilibrium across the entire timing matrix, our directional lean for today's session is strictly neutral, favoring range-bound consolidation until clear volume-backed price action breaks the current deadlock.
